scope: Complete numbered English editorial study adaptations Q101–200, official PDF pages 1–50 (printed 28–77). questionCandidates.text: Which optical process underlies the Raman effect?
issues: Tentative C, final B. Raman scattering is physically inelastic; the official choices use different terminology.

questionCandidates.text: Match communities with regions as listed: a) Masai b) Saami c) Kalinga d) Bushmen. 1 Angola; 2 Kenya; 3 Philippines; 4 Siberia.
issues: Official key A retained for review, but the Saami–Siberia pairing is geographically questionable; not a verified geography fact.
